name: Espresso Brownies
description: Cocoa brownies with a shot of espresso, from a tabular recipe card.
ingredients: 1 shot (4 Tbsp, 60 mL) fresh brewed espresso or very strong coffee
steps: Butter and flour an 8x8-inch pan; heat the oven to 350 F (175 C).
Stir in the sugar, vanilla and espresso.
Fold in the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt until just combined.
Spread in the pan and bake 30-40 minutes. Leave to cool completely in the pan, which can take hours.
notes: The source card gives 170 C for 350 F; 350 F is about 177 C, so 175 C here.
Baking soda, not baking powder: an early version of the source said powder and was corrected.
A glass pan gives a gooier result.
